note_tweet.text:
Boy Undone is a Mexican drama-thriller film directed and written by Leopoldo Laborde, released in Mexico on May 31, 2017, with a running time of 1 hour 
+ 40 minutes + a few seconds. 
The film stars Paul Act, Eduardo Longoria, and others. 
The original name of this film is:
 'Memorias de lo que no fue'.

The original language of this film is Mexican Spanish, and there are American English subtitles in this video. This full film is available for free watching here on X.

Two lads met at a night club on May 5, 2016 and spent the night together. The next day, however, Miguel, the host woke up to find Fernando, the lad in his arms confused, unable to remember his name or anything about his past. Lacking any form of identification or obvious clues, the lads begin searching for the truth in fragments of memory that may prove reliable or unreliable. This is a chilling thriller.

Fernando (Paul Act)  &  Miguel ( Eduardo Longoria): their true and deep love.

'A friend in need is a friend indeed' - I remember this catchphrase from English class when I was in elementary/primary school, and maybe even high/secondary school. After watching this film, I would like to paraphrase this famous English catchphrase as follows:
'A boyfriend in need is a boyfriend indeed'
                or in another way:
'A soulmate in need is a soulmate indeed'

This film vividly shows that true love saves, helping to win over a vile and cynical world. I personally rejoice in the victory of these guys and their happiness.
